verdict.rationale: BVNK is fundamentally an API/platform product with Hawk-authenticated REST APIs, webhooks for automated notifications, and a sandbox environment explicitly meant for testing integrations before going live — all of which support headless, script-driven or CI-based automation. A probe also surfaces an official 'agent-wallet-cli' repo, suggesting a CLI path for automation-style usage. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, or non-interactive automation guides beyond the sandbox/testing framing. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, official SDK examples for automated pipelines, and confirmation that the agent-wallet-cli is production-documented rather than a bare repo.
